question: Which memory-core Dreaming scoping API should this issue accept: per-agent agents.list[].dreaming.enabled, a global plugins.entries.memory-core.config.dreaming.agents allowlist, schedule staggering, or a separate pressure-backoff path?
rationale: The source problem is real, but the durable config location and schedule semantics are product/API choices with compatibility impact that automation should not decide from the issue alone.

options.title: Accept Scoped Agent Allowlist First
options.body: Land a schema-backed global dreaming agent allowlist as the minimum fix for bounded sweeps, then track per-agent schedules or stagger offsets separately.

options.title: Require Per-Agent Overrides
options.body: Keep this issue scoped to agents.list[].dreaming.enabled and possibly schedule fields, accepting the larger agent-config API surface for direct per-agent control.

options.title: Solve With Scheduler Pressure Policy
options.body: Treat OOM risk as a scheduler/backoff problem and leave per-agent scoping for a later feature after pressure handling lands.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Agent Allowlist First
recommendation.body: Land a schema-backed global dreaming agent allowlist as the minimum fix for bounded sweeps, then track per-agent schedules or stagger offsets separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent dreaming resolver/runtime history and config compatibility policy make this the strongest available owner signal for the API decision.
